description: Where the GPU overtakes the CPU: the benchmark problem on 1024 x 1024 cells, 100 steps, with one rank of 36 threads (one socket, with one GPU in the GPU build) and with two ranks (both sockets, both GPUs). experiments/gpu_size_*.json differ only in the size; the GPU build writes gpu_sizes_gpu.csv, and the CPU build, run with --metrics-csv, gpu_sizes_cpu.csv. Compare the time per CG iteration: the number of steps is smaller on the large grids to keep the runs short.
